enabled: Warband combat enabled. Hold LMB to wind up, release to strike. RMB to block, mouse to choose direction. Shift for vanilla interactions.
hint: LMB: attack · RMB: block · K: toggle
pvp-required: Directional combat is required in PvP worlds. Shift keeps vanilla block interactions.
hit-diagnostics-on: Warband hit diagnostics enabled. F8 toggles the collider and result display. Details: client-main.log, [Warband Hit].
hit-debug-legend: Green: blade · Blue: previous sample · F8: hide
hit-debug-no-contact: Blade did not intersect a target
hit-debug-terrain-blocked-target: Terrain cut off a target contact
hit-debug-client-no-packet: Model contact; client sent no damage packet
hit-debug-not-sampled: Cancelled or no collision frames tested
hit-debug-no-server-reply: Server did not reply within 2 s
hit-debug-not-physical-weapon: Server: weapon does not use physical contacts
hit-debug-invalid-target-or-position: Server: invalid target or contact point
hit-debug-contact-refused: Server refused contact during damage processing
hit-debug-native-no-result: CO returned without a damage result
hit-debug-co-out-of-range: CO rejected: target out of reach
hit-debug-co-unconfigured-damage-type: CO rejected: damage type absent from weapon
hit-debug-co-tier-too-high: CO rejected: damage tier exceeds limit
hit-debug-co-armor-piercing-too-high: CO rejected: armor piercing exceeds limit
hit-debug-co-durability-too-high: CO rejected: durability cost exceeds limit
